AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAI‘I AIRPORT RESCUE FIREFIGHTING UNIT (ARFF) PURSUANT TO HAWAI‘I REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7, FOR MUTUAL ASSISTANCE WITH THE HAWAI‘I FIRE DEPARTMENT IN A FIRE EMERGENCY

Seeks to enter into a Memorandum of Agreement to facilitate joint recruit classes between the Hawai‘i Fire Department and State Airport Rescue Firefighters and clarify their roles regarding firefighter recruit training.

Latest action: Council: Adopst Res. 573-24 & GOEAC-148 - 8/21/2024

entry.title: New: Resolution 562 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR (Draft 2) AGREEMENT WITH HAWAIʻI ISLAND EV, LLC, TO REPLACE HAWAIʻI COUNTY SHARED-USE ELECTRIC VEHICLES

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a ten-year lease agreement with an approximate monthly cost of $7,200, to replace the County’s disposed shared-use electric vehicle fleet with seven new electric vehicles.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 562-24, Draft 3; adopts FC-180 - 8/21/2024

entry.title: New: Resolution 552 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR A MULTI-YEAR LEASE OF REAL PROPERTY FOR THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI OFFICE OF HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with Kaneshiro & Sons Enterprise, Limited and Glenn Kaneshiro Partnership, with an approximate monthly cost of $1,827, for office space located at 1990 Kinoʻole Street.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 552-24 & FC-174 - 07/24/24

entry.title: New: Resolution 547 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
APPROVES THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION 2024 TITLE VI PLAN PURSUANT TO THE FEDERAL TRANSIT ADMINISTRATION TITLE VI CIRCULAR 4702.1B REQUIREMENTS AND GUIDELINES

Adoption of the plan fulfills federal requirements to ensure that the department provides public transit service in conformance with Title VI legislation, which prohibits discrimination on the basis of race, color, or national origin.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 547-24 & PCHSW-13 - 07/24/24
